title: It's Showtime at the Apollo
description:

It's Showtime at the Apollo is a syndicated music television show, first broadcast on September 12, 1987. The show features live performances from both professional and up-and-coming artists, and also features the Amateur Night competition.

description:
S3 E3 — Don Knotts, Melba Moore
Don Knotts does a medical convention monologue and disrupts officer Freddie Johnson’s date with Melba Moore.

description:
S3 E4 — Ruth Buzzi, Burns & Schreiber, The Surpremes
Flip & cast do park bench skits; Burns & Schreiber do their taxi routine and Buzzi & The Supremes compete to rent Flip a car.

description:
S3 E5 — Stiller & Meara, Bill Russell
Flip & Bill Russell give a clinic on billiards; Stiller & Meara have a lunchroom romance and a courtroom scene features the whole cast.

description:
S3 E6 — The Jackson 5, David Steinberg, Diana Sands
Flip pushes ice cream and tries to join the Jackson 5; Michael gives a math lesson; Steinberg burglarizes Flip & Diana Sands.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E1 — Jack Benny, Pearl Bailey
Jack Benny plays a gypsy violinist and an unwelcome boarder in the home of an arguing couple (Flip & Pearl).

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E7 — Ed Asner, Carol Channing
Ed Asner plays a ship's captain, cheats at cards (w/Flip, Channing & George Wyle) and gets fixed up with Carol at a resort.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E16 — Family Affair
Still angry at Frank for keeping his true relationship to Dorian a secret for so long, Moesha decides not to introduce her father at an upcoming 'Businessman of the Year' awards banquet.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E17 — The Matchmaker
Hoping to boost the confidence of her new roommate, Theresa, Moesha asks Hakeem’s good-looking friend to ask Theresa on a date – but can’t leave well enough alone when the date is a success.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E18 — Gimme A Break
Moesha, Niecy, and Hakeem go to Santa Barbara for Spring Break. A campus rival spreads false information that Mo is 'easy' when her ex-boyfriend shows interest in Moesha.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E19 — Something About Moesha
Having been neighbors and friends nearly all their lives, Moesha and Hakeem wonder if there is more to their relationship.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E20 — The Robbing Hood
Moesha and Hakeem explore their evolving dating relationship.  Dorian visits Moesha on campus and Moesha sees this as a chance to forge a sister/brother relationship; items begin missing from dorm rooms and all clues lead towards Dorian.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E21 — Arriving Right On Q
Moesha and Hakeem’s relationship hits a snag when Q returns to town; sparks fly between Moesha and Q;  Q invites Moesha to spend the summer (as a road manager) on tour with his rap group.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E22 — D-Money Loses His Patience
Hakeem tries to convince Moesha to pass on Q’s offer to go on the road with his band, and focus on her priorities: school, family, and him.  Moesha admits to being too distracted to make a clear decision.

title: Moesha
description:
S6 E1 — On The Rebound
Moesha and Q decide whether or not to take their relationship to the next level; Dorian returns home from boot camp.
